# RAMYACHANDRA GUNASEKERA CHAMBERS

> Premium legal counsel, court advocacy, notarial conveyancing, and company secretarial governance in Sri Lanka with over 35 years of distinguished practice.

## Overview
- **Chambers**: RAMYACHANDRA GUNASEKERA CHAMBERS
- **Principal Counsel**: Ramyachandra Gunasekera, Attorney-at-Law, Notary Public, Commissioner for Oaths, Registered Company Secretary (DRC).
- **Experience**: Over three decades (35+ years) of active practice in District Courts, High Courts, Magistrate's Courts, and appellate tribunals across Sri Lanka.
- **Offices**:
  - Head Office: Court Road, Matara Fort, Matara 81000, Southern Province, Sri Lanka.
  - Corporate & Residence Chambers: Kotavila Road, Kamburugamuwa (near Mirissa), Southern Province, Sri Lanka.
- **Client Base**: Domestic individuals, corporate enterprises, and international clients across 40+ countries (including UK, EU, UAE, Australia, USA).

## Core Practice Areas
- **Court Advocacy & Litigation**: Comprehensive representation across Sri Lankan judicial hierarchy. Criminal defense, bail applications, civil trials, land disputes, partition actions, money recovery, fundamental rights, and testamentary/probate proceedings.
- **Notarial Services & Property Conveyancing**: Title deed drafting, deeds of transfer, deeds of gift, lease agreements, mortgage bonds, comprehensive title investigations (search of encumbrances) at Land Registries across Southern Province.
- **Company Secretarial & Corporate Compliance**: Registered Company Secretary under the Department of the Registrar of Companies (DRC) and Companies Act No. 07 of 2007. End-to-end company incorporation, Beneficial Ownership (BO) compliance, Articles of Association, and Inland Revenue Department TIN registration.
- **Foreign Investment & Cross-Border Advisory**: Assisting overseas individuals, expatriates, and foreign corporations in lawful acquisition of Sri Lankan real estate, commercial ventures, non-resident powers of attorney, and statutory compliance.
- **Labour & Employment Law**: Employment contracts, disciplinary procedure advisory, termination matters, EPF/ETF statutory compliance, and representation before the Labour Tribunal.
